title: Looking for Serious Investors – XAUUSD Account Management + Mentorship
author: WA-17032003
selftext:
Looking for Serious Investors – XAUUSD Account Management + Mentorship

I've been trading XAUUSD (Gold) for the past 7 years, focusing exclusively on Price Action, SMC, and ICT concepts. I don't trade other forex pairs because I prefer to specialize in one market.

I'm offering a 3-month account management + mentorship service for people who:

Have $500+ trading capital

Don't know how to trade, or

Are consistently losing money and want to improve.

What I offer:

I trade your account using strict risk management (typically 1–5% risk per trade).

My target is generally around a 1:3 risk-to-reward ratio.

I teach you my approach while managing your account so you understand every step.

After 3 months, the goal is for you to trade confidently on your own.

Profit Split:

50/50 profit share

No upfront fees

No paid course

No signal group

My historical strategy has achieved around an 80% win rate, but all trading involves risk, and profits are never guaranteed. Past performance does not guarantee future results.

If you're a serious investor and interested in working together, send me a DM. Please only reach out if you're genuinely interested and have the required capital.
